laws.rule: Gujarat has prohibition under the Gujarat Prohibition Act 1949. Visitors aged 21 or more, including foreign tourists, can get a liquor permit through the state's e-permit system and buy only at an authorised shop; drinking without a permit is an offence.
Gir forest visitor guidance prohibits feeding wildlife, bringing pets, collecting flora and fauna as souvenirs, and littering; carry rubbish out.

layers.process: Champaner Group of Monuments: the Archaeological Survey of India lists this monument among its ticketed sites.
